findings.text: follow-on: _authored_plan_impl duplicates the authored plan-impl meta extraction that already exists at reckon/doccheck.py:1533 (soup.find("meta", {"name": "plan-impl"}) then float), a third copy of the same idiom beside the one inline in reckon/_plan_html.py:1122; it neither extends nor wraps the existing reader.

follow-on: the log's first line names "head 981a7457", the reviewed base rather than the fix head d2ea7953, so it does not evidence a head-tree run as the manifest contract requires and the "no added failure against base" claim is unverifiable from the log alone.

follow-on: _authored_plan_impl returns None when the plan file carries no plan-impl meta, which _plan_html.write_state deliberately omits for a declarations-derived impl (reckon/_plan_html.py:2056), so a plan that authored no such meta is exempt from the guard ("no-impl-recorded-at-dispatch"); this restores the pre-derivation contract the pinned tests encode but diverges from the brief's "read from the derivation" and the plan section's served-figure wording, and the worker disclosed the tension in its follow_ons.
